$comment: Rise defaults for RehabNinja — not clinical standards. Inspired by acl-rehab exercise lists; rewritten for TKA/THA/hip-fracture POD bands. Models never author these.

exercises.name: Chair sit-to-stand
exercises.notes: Rise from the chair without pushing off with your hands if you can. Knees over feet.
exercises.ninjaHint: Fruit slices at the top of each clean stand.

exercises.name: Mini squat
exercises.notes: Shallow squat only. Keep knees tracking over your feet.
exercises.ninjaHint: Fruit slices when you rise from a clean mini squat.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg with support nearby. Stay steady — stop if unsafe.
exercises.ninjaHint: Fruit fills while you hold still; bombs if you sway hard.
